title: Zeynab Javadli, ex-wife of Dubai prince Sheikh Saeed, alleges UAE officials drugged her, took daughters
summary_full: Zeynab Javadli, former wife of Dubai prince Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum, has approached the United Nations seeking an investigation into allegations that UAE officials assaulted and drugged her during a raid in which her three daughters were taken away. Her legal team has also raised concerns over her alleged torture in custody and the children's whereabouts.
